doc:
The syntax `arr[i]` gets the `i`'th element of the collection `arr`. If there
are proof side conditions to the application, they will be automatically
inferred by the `get_elem_tactic` tactic.


Conventions for notations in identifiers:

 * The recommended spelling of `xs[i]` in identifiers is `getElem`.

 * The recommended spelling of `xs[i]'h` in identifiers is `getElem`.
name: GetElem.getElem
typeText:
{coll : Type u} →
  {idx : Type v} →
    {elem : outParam.{w + 2} (Type w)} →
      {valid : outParam.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} (coll → idx → Prop)} →
        [self : GetElem.{u, v, w} coll idx elem valid] → (xs : coll) → (i : idx) → valid xs i → elem

source.code: getElem (xs : coll) (i : idx) (h : valid xs i) : elem
